4ff63fdc1bd8.title: Keisuke Nagashima’s D1NZ Championship AE86 | Auto Biography
4ff63fdc1bd8.summary: When Keisuke Nagashima shipped his iconic turbo AE86—a recent D1NZ Championship car—all the way from New Zealand to the United States for Final Bout and Super D, we couldn't pass up the opportunity to pull him aside for an in-depth look at the build.  In this episode of Auto Biography, Keisuke walks us through the evolution of his championship-winning Corolla. From its origins in New Zealand's grassroots drifting and inspiration drawn from Japanese drift legends, we dive deep into the setup that lets him shred in his ultra aggressive Meihan style of drifting.  We break down: The Origin & D1NZ History: How the build came to life, its New Zealand roots, and key influences.  Engine & Performance: The power plant that drives his aggressive style.  Suspension & Chassis Setup: Crafting the ultimate response for competitive tandem drifting.  Aesthetic & Exterior Style: The signature 86Fighters look and livery.  What's Next: Keisuke's future plans for the car after its US tour.  🔗 FOLLOW THE CREW & DRIVER  Follow Keisuke Nagashima on YT:   @86Fighters     Follow on IG:  @86fighters   Subscribe to Auto Biography for more in-depth drift histories and car stories  #AutoBiography #86Fighters #AE86 #D1NZ #FinalBout #SuperD #Drifting #4AGE #CorollaAE86 #JDM #DriftCulture

6ce99bd0f59b.title: The SEMA Show has changed over the years…
6ce99bd0f59b.summary: The SEMA Show is always one of the biggest events in the automotive aftermarket, but has it changed for better or worse?

005ade9a7c8a.title: The rise of PERFORMANCE SEDANS… Are 4 doors better than 2?
005ade9a7c8a.summary: Nick and Matt break down the modern lineup of enthusiast sedans—from heavy hitters like the Honda Civic Type R and Acura Integra Type S to the best performance 4-doors on the market today.

b9e6971ba742.title: OEM+ vs. Custom Builds: What’s the BEST Way to Build a Car?
b9e6971ba742.summary: How far should you go when modifying your car? Is an OEM+ build the perfect balance of factory styling and tasteful upgrades, or is going fully custom with aftermarket parts the best way to build something truly unique? Is there even really a correct answer?

e1bd1189421d.title: The Best & Worst factory wheels… “WHY ARE THE WHEELS SQUARE?!”
e1bd1189421d.summary: Matt and Nick talk about why project cars are almost never truly complete. As new technology, new parts, and new ideas come along, there’s always something else you could add, upgrade, replace, or improve.
